# temps_project_group_route (Resource)

Serves a path of one project of a group from another project of the group, in each environment both have (`/api` of the web app answered by the API project).

Import with `<group_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_group_route" "api" {
  group_id          = temps_project_group.shop.id
  source_project_id = temps_project.web.id
  target_project_id = temps_project.api.id
  path_prefix       = "/api"
  strip_prefix      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) ID of the project group.
- `path_prefix` (String) Path prefix that is routed, for example `/api`.
- `source_project_id` (Number) Project whose address receives the requests.
- `target_project_id` (Number) Project that answers them.

### Optional

- `strip_prefix` (Boolean) Remove the prefix before forwarding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<group_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <group_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_project_group_route.api 2/6
```
